svg.title: Every public format, by family: 86 families, 2,560 formats
svg.desc: 86 families of public formats in 11 domains, 2,560 formats in all; each family is shown with its number of packs, counted from packs/. Air: ASTERIX 30, ADS-B 2, readsb JSON 2, GDL 90 1. Land vehicles: CAN DBC (opendbc) 91, Baidu Apollo 48, Tier IV (ROS 2) 13, ASAM OSI (Open Simulation Interface) 12, Autoware (ROS 2) 11, Eclipse KUKSA.val 8, Tesla Fleet Telemetry 5, Waymo Open Dataset 2, COVESA VSS 1, OpenXC 1. Sea: AIS 2, NMEA 2000 2, NMEA 0183 1. Space: Space Data Standards 297, CCSDS frames and packets 12, CCSDS NDM/XML 1. Uncrewed systems and robots: ArduPilot DataFlash log 342, PX4 ULog 301, Cyphal (UAVCAN v1) 250, Gazebo messages (gz-msgs) 219, DroneCAN (UAVCAN v0) 133, ROS 2 interface packages 62, Foxglove 48, Parrot ARSDK 44, MAVLink 2 14, Open-RMF (ROS 2) 13, DRIP (RFC 9575) 1, Remote ID (ASTM F3411) 1. C2 and tactical: Cursor on Target 2, UCI 2, A-GRA 1, C2SIM 1, Canonical Track v2 1, DIS (IEEE 1278.1) 1, GeoTrackV1 1, NVG 1. Sensors: NITF 2.1 32, SBP (Swift Navigation) 22, Septentrio SBF 17, u-blox UBX 14, ISA 4, MISB local sets 3, SAPIENT 2, gpsd JSON 1, RTCM 3 1, Unicore UNI 1. Transport: GBFS 84, GTFS Schedule 31, WZDx 10, GOFS 8, NeTEx 4, GTFS Realtime 2, MDS 1, Valhalla 1. IoT: FIWARE Smart Data Models 93, Meshtastic 12, Sparkplug B 1. Networks: OCSF 79, STIX 2.1 39, IETF packet headers 27, OpenTelemetry OTLP 9, gNMI 8, IETF option areas 2, OpenC2 2, CACAO playbooks 1, CloudEvents 1, Elastic Common Schema 1. Maps, weather and alerts: aviationweather.gov Data API 18, NWS weather.gov API 18, Overture Maps 15, OpenStreetMap PBF 3, NHC tropical cyclone status 2, USGS earthquake feed 2, CAP alerts 1, Geobuf 1, GeoJSON 1, GPX 1, KML 1, Mapbox Vector Tile 1, NASA EONET events 1, NOAA CO-OPS tides and currents 1, STAC Item 1. Not shown: the 211 synthetic packs whose names start with conformance or demo-, which exercise the specification and stand for no real format.
svg.text: Every public format, by family: 86 families, 2,560 formats
Each tile is one family and the number of its packs in packs/, in 11 domains. The 211 synthetic
conformance and demo packs are not shown.
AOS, TC, TM, USLP, Proximity-1, CLCW, Space Packet, Encapsulation Packet, CFDP, CUC, CDS, CCS
common and 13 dialects: ardupilotmega, asluav, avssuas, csairlink, cubepilot, development,
icarous, loweheiser, marsh, paparazzi, stemstudios, storm32, uavionix
ARP, BFD, BGP, CoAP, DNS, DTLS, Geneve, GRE, ICMP, ICMPv6, IGMPv2, IGMPv3, IPv4, IPv6, MPLS,
NTP, OSPFv2, RIPv2, RTCP, RTP, SCTP, TCP, TLS, UDP, VRRPv3 (IPv4), VRRPv3 (IPv6), VXLAN
commands and responses: language 1.1, stateless packet filter profile 1.1
METAR, TAF, PIREP, SIGMET/AIRMET, CWA, TCF, stations and navigational data
GeoJSON summary feed: one event, the whole feed
CurrentStorms.json: one storm, the whole file
